stemMarkdown: At what rate percent per annum of simple interest will a sum of money become 2 times itself in 5 years? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: To become 2 times itself, the interest earned must be $1$ times the principal. So $\dfrac{P \times R \times 5}{100} = 1P$, giving $R = \dfrac{1 \times 100}{5} = 20.0\%$.
